title: ServingManifest
description: data/manifest.json: the one fixed URL the site reads (ADR-098, docs/DATA_CONTRACTS.md section 21). It names every served file by content hash, carries each source artifact's envelope without its records, and carries build_metadata.json and ros_build_metadata.json verbatim. Derived by `ffdraft package-site-data`; `ffdraft validate-artifacts` requires it byte-identical to a fresh derivation.

artifacts.description: Source artifact name -> its envelope without `records`. Its `schema_version` is what the page checks before reading a slice of it; its `build_id` is restored into every record that carried the envelope's build id.

ros_build_metadata.description: ros_build_metadata.json, verbatim, when an in-season bundle was published.

files.description: Served key -> the first 16 hex digits of the file's SHA-256. Key `players`, `<family>/<partition>` or `card/<league>.<scoring>/<bucket>`; the file is served at data/serve/<key>.<hash>.json.
